question: In Andhra region, who among the following translated a few portions of Mahabharata in Telugu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nanniah**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nanniah** translated a few portions of Mahabharata in Telugu in the Andhra region.
 
• Nanniah is often considered one of the early translators and poets who contributed significantly to Telugu literature.
 
• The Mahabharata is one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India, the other being the Ramayana.
 
• The translation of such epics into regional languages played a crucial role in the cultural and literary development of the regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tikkanna** and **Errana** are also renowned for their contributions to the translation of Mahabharata in Telugu, but Nanniah is noted for initiating the work.
 
• **Kamban** is known for his Tamil rendition of the Ramayana.
 
• **Pampa** was a Kannada poet known for his work "Adipurana" and "Pampa Bharata".
 
• The translation of epic texts into regional languages helped in disseminating the epic's teachings and stories to a broader audience.
